posts.text: For those confused by the sudden and seemingly coordinated invective against “post-liberalism” and “integralism,” the terms are slogans to mask a neo-Know-Nothing contempt for Catholics. It’s not that they don’t refer to real ideas. But in common harangues, they simply express opposition to Catholics, much as “Zionist” and “Talmudic,” also real and distinct concepts, usually just mean “Jew.”
